ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discrete, high-contrast circular white clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes. A concentration of high-intensity white streaks and spots is visible towards the distal tips and along the mid-section of both lobes against a solid dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees; notch apex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks are visible on the interior sections, transitioning to more pronounced, jagged irregular topography at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave upward sweep from the median notch to the tips, creating a symmetrical tapered profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) scattered across both lobes, with larger clusters localized on the lower mid-sections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin white linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe (image right) and shorter horizontal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across the fluke surface due to barnacle attachment and linear raking. The distal tips exhibit irregular, non-symmetrical wear/erosion patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density distribution of white rosette scars creating a 'star-field' pattern across the dark pigmentation.
